description:
Amendment 0001 to Solicitation No. 19SA4026R0006 VPN DIA & Circuit Leasing Services:

This amendment is issued to:
1) Incorporate the questions and answers.
2) Extend the proposal submission deadline from February 16, 2026, to March 6, 2026 no later than 5:00 PM (local time).


All other terms and conditions of the solicitation remain unchanged.
